$comment: Standing platform test checklist — area ledger. Hand-edited, append-only; validated by scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (pnpm check:platform-checklist). Authoring rules: docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md · execution protocol: RUNNER.md.
title: REST / batch / formula / build-time gates

items.title: transactionalBatch capability bit matches the mounted /batch behavior
steps: exercise /api/v1/batch: a well-formed atomic batch, then atomic:false

acceptance.clause: the discovery bit is true exactly when /batch is mounted and transaction-capable; atomic:false answers 400 BATCH_NOT_ATOMIC
acceptance.verify: capability read + the two batch calls with their status/error codes

items.title: Formula runtime fixes hold and date-arithmetic fails at build time
steps: evaluate the fixed runtime shapes against built @objectstack/formula: due_date == today(), cond ? x : null, floor/ceil
run os build on a config carrying date arithmetic (end - start + 1)

acceptance.verify: harness run against the BUILT package (not src) returns the expected values

acceptance.clause: date arithmetic is a build-time ERROR in os build — not a runtime surprise
acceptance.verify: os build exits non-zero with the located formula error

items.title: Removed/retired authoring keys fail at parse/build with located guidance
steps: author a config using a retired key (per the ADR-0087 registries / retiredKey tombstones)

acceptance.clause: the parse/build rejects the retired key with located guidance naming the replacement — never a silent strip for tombstoned keys
acceptance.verify: ObjectSchema.create / os build throws the located error for a sampled retired key

negative: also sample one key documented as silently-stripped-by-design (e.g. pure display annotations) to confirm the strip stays deliberate and documented, not accidental

items.title: Server-Timing spans emit for admins only — on the server os dev actually runs
steps: with OS_SERVER_TIMING enabled, request any route as admin with X-OS-Debug-Timing

acceptance.clause: admin responses carry auth/db/hooks/serialize spans; non-admin responses carry none — verified against the hono server os dev runs, because the #3361 regression lived exactly in the dispatcher-vs-hono seam while unit tests simulated the call and stayed green
acceptance.verify: live response headers for both personas on the running dev server

history.change: initial import from #3358; oracle pinned to the live server because of #3361
